responsibility: Declares the SysV4-specific PowerPC option table entries layered on top of the generic rs6000 options. It covers ABI selection via -mcall-, small-data and TLS-size controls, endian and relocatable switches, 32/64-bit mode selection, secure-PLT and pltseq behavior, and related target variables that sysv4.h and derivative OS headers interpret when configuring the backend.
same_name_distinction: This is the generated-option definition file for the SysV4 rs6000 target: it declares the -mcall-, -msdata, endianness, relocatable, 32/64-bit, secure-PLT, pltseq, and related switches and binds them to target variables such as rs6000_abi_name and rs6000_sdata_name. Unlike sysv4.h, it does not implement the ABI/spec logic; it only defines the command-line options that sysv4.h later interprets.
